design_doc.project_name: Free Cash Finance Automation Daily Monitoring Agent

operational_constraints_enforcement.implementation: Detection-only mode: System identifies potential earnings/signals but queues for trigger rather than executing actions. All action paths must have explicit 'trigger' flag in request payload.
operational_constraints_enforcement.guardrail: Action queue with dry-run validation before any external interaction

operational_constraints_enforcement.implementation: Cron-based scheduler executes exactly one validation cycle per 24h period. Lock file prevents duplicate runs. Historical timestamp tracked for compliance.
operational_constraints_enforcement.guardrail: Idempotency tokens ensure single-record updates on duplicate-trigger conditions

operational_constraints_enforcement.implementation: Alert-only channel: Notifications sent via configured channels (email/SMS/Slack) describing detected events. No processing of notifications occurs; they are human-facing informational only.
operational_constraints_enforcement.guardrail: All notifications route to alert inbox, never trigger downstream automations

operational_constraints_enforcement.implementation: Approval queue with configurable timeout (default 7d). Actions await explicit human confirmation via approved channel. System provides context: event summary, recommended response, risk level.
operational_constraints_enforcement.guardrail: Hard gate on all payment/invoice/vendor actions; even low-value items require manual approval

design_doc.architecture_diagram:
+------------------+    +---------------+    +-------------+
|                   |    |               |    |             |
|  DATA SOURCES     |--> |  MONITOR AGENT|--> | ALERT QUEUE |
|                   |    |              |    |             |
| - Bank API        |    | - Polling     |    | - Email     |
| - Finance API     |    |   (daily)    |    | - SMS/Slack |
| - Invoice Mgmt    |    | - Validation  |    |             |
| - Transaction DB  |    | - Queue       |    +----+--------+
|                   |    |   Manager     |         |
+------------------+    +-------+--------+        |<-
                                |          +------+
                                v            v
                        +---------------+    +-------------+
                        | APPROVAL REQ  |--> | NOTIFIED TO |
                        | QUEUE        |    | HUMAN       |
                        +-------+-------+    | WORKSPACE   |
                                |            +-------------+
                                v                       
                        +---------------+    +-----------+
                        |   ACTION     |<---| CONSUMED BY|
                        | ENGINE       |    | APPROVAL UI|
                        +---------------+    +-----------+

  Legend:
  [Data Sources]       = External APIs/feeds (no action capability)
  [Monitor Agent]      = Core scheduler with polling orchestration (detection only)
  [Alert Queue]        = Notification channel aggregator
  [Approval Request]   = Human-in-the-loop approval queue
  [Notified To Human]  = Actionable workspace for decision makers

daily_check_workflow.title: Daily Cycle Initialization
actions: Acquire cycle lock file to prevent duplicate execution
Record start timestamp and validate within maintenance window
Increment daily_run counter for audit trail
daily_check_workflow.conditions: Cycle must trigger exactly once per 24h based on scheduled cron/timer
exceptions: If locked: Exit early, log 'cycle already executed'
If outside maintenance window: Skip with warning logged

daily_check_workflow.title: Data Fetching and Validation
actions: Fetch latest status from all configured data sources
Validate response integrity and API health for each source
Compare new data against last valid snapshot for change detection
daily_check_workflow.conditions: All sources must respond successfully; mark as partial if minor failures occur
exceptions: On critical source failure: Alert immediately, continue with available data
On transient error (timeout): Retry 3x with exponential backoff before failing

daily_check_workflow.title: Detection and Alerting
actions: Apply detection logic to identify earnings/signals/opportunities
Create alert record for each change detected (do NOT create action)
Generate human-readable notification with full context
Route notifications through configured channels per user preference
daily_check_workflow.conditions: Detect-only mode: no actions queued at this stage, alerts informational only
exceptions: On detection without data source error: Proceed to alert generation
On partial detection (some sources missing): Document gap, proceed with available data

pseudocode.description: Monitoring agent pseudocode with constraint enforcement
pseudocode.code:
# FREE CASH FINANCE AUTOMATION MONITORING AGENT
# Constraint Enforcement:
#   1. Detection only - no auto action on earnings
#   2. Single daily cycle via lock-based scheduling
#   3. Notifications informational only
#   4. Human approval gate for all external actions

class FreeCashMonitorAgent:
    __init__(self, config):
        self.lock_dir = config['lock_directory']
        self.alert_channels = config['alert_channels']
        self.data_sources = [
            config['bank_api_config'],
            config['finance_platform_config'],
            config['invoice_mgmt_config'],
            config['transaction_ledger_config']
        ]
        self.daily_run_counter = 0
        
    def acquire_cycle_lock(self):
        """Prevent duplicate daily runs"""
        lock_file = os.path.join(self.lock_dir, f'cycle_{datetime.now().date()}.lock')
        if os.path.exists(lock_file):
            raise CycleAlreadyExecutedError(f'Duplicate run blocked: {lock_file}')
        fd, _ = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=self.lock_dir)
        try:
            os.fsync(fd)
            return True
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
    
    def release_cycle_lock(self):
        """Release lock after daily cycle complete"""
        lock_file = os.path.join(self.lock_dir, f'cycle_{datetime.now().date()}.lock')
        if os.path.exists(lock_file):
            os.remove(lock_file)
    
    def run_daily_cycle(self):
        """Execute single validation cycle - Constraint #2"""
        print('Starting daily check cycle...')
        self.daily_run_counter += 1
        
        try:
            self.acquire_cycle_lock()
            cycle_start = datetime.utcnow()
            
            # Step 1: Fetch all source data
            source_data = {}
            for source_config in self.data_sources:
                response = self.fetch_source(
                    source_name=source_config['name'],
                    config=source_config
                )
                source_data[source_config['name']] = response
            
            # Step 2: Detect changes - Constraint #1: detection only
            events_detected = []
            for source_name, data in source_data.items():
                detected_events = self.detect_changes(
                    source=source_name,
                    current=data,
                    historical=self.historical_snapshots[source_name]
                )
                
                # Constraint #1 & #3: Generate alerts only, NO actions yet
                for event in detected_events:
                    alert_record = AlertRecord(
                        event_id=f'{{ECN-{cycle_start.month:02d}{cycle_start.day:02d}+{self.daily_run_counter}-{len(events_detected)}}}',
                        source=source_name,
                        details=event,
                        timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat()+'Z'
                    )
                    events_detected.append(alert_record)
            
            # Step 3: Send notifications - Constraint #3: informative only
            for alert in events_detected:
                self.notify_channels(
                    channels=self.alert_channels,
                    alert=alert
                )
                # NOTE: Do NOT queue action here
                # All actions require explicit human trigger later
            
            self.historical_snapshots.update(source_data)
            
        finally:
            self.release_cycle_lock()
        
    def notify_channels(self, channels, alert):
        """Send informative notifications via all configured channels"""
        message = f"[ALERT] {{alert.event_type}}: {{alert.source}}\n{{alert.details}}\nACTION_REQUIRED: Human review needed"
        for channel in channels:
            send_notification(
                target=channel.address,
                type=channel.type,
                content=message
            )
    
    def trigger_action(self, event_id):
        """Explicit action trigger - ONLY called after human approval (Constraint #4)"""
        alert = self.alert_queue.get(event_id)
        if alert.status != 'APPROVED':
            raise ActionBlockedError(f'Event {{event_id}} not approved or pending')
        
        # Now safe to execute action only after human approval
        return self.execute_approve(
            event=alert.event,
            user_id=approver_user_identity  # from audit trail
        )
    
    def check_status(self):
        """Main entry point - delegates to run_daily_cycle"""
        try:
            self.run_daily_cycle()
        except CycleAlreadyExecutedError as e:
            print(f'{e} - skipping redundant execution')
notes: Class uses lock file per date for single daily execution
Detection methods only populate alert records, never actions queue
Notifications sent but do not trigger any automatic processing
Explicit trigger method enforces approval requirement before action
